sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chatbots to autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use. Highlighted how LangGraph enables developers to build reliable agent workflows with state management and human-in-the-loop capabilities.

sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder @ Latent.Space | AI Engineer
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on the current state of AI infrastructure, emphasizing the shift from monolithic models to composable agent systems. Covered the rise of local inference tools and open-source frameworks that are democratizing AI development for individual developers.

sources.author: Clemens Siebert
sources.headline: Head of AI @ Automattic
sources.post_summary: Explored how AI automation is transforming WordPress development workflows, from code generation to automated testing and deployment. Shared practical examples of using AI agents to reduce development cycles by 40% while maintaining code quality standards.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction | Investor
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the investment landscape for AI infrastructure companies, noting that agent platforms and developer tooling are seeing the highest growth in Series A/B rounds. Emphasized the importance of building for developer experience over raw model performance.

sources.author: Elena Vasquez
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Notion | Ex-Salesforce
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a GTM engineering function that combines RevOps, data, and automation to reduce CAC by 30%. Shared a framework for aligning product, marketing, and sales data pipelines with outbound sequences.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: Head of Sales Ops @ Ramp
sources.post_summary: Explained how his team automated lead scoring and enrichment using Clay + custom scripts, cutting SDR ramp time in half. Included before/after metrics and a simple tech stack diagram.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Founder @ GTM Labs | Former Director of Content @ HubSpot
sources.post_summary: Shared a content-to-pipeline attribution model that ties thought leadership posts directly to SQL creation. Highlighted how content strategy should be measured by revenue influence, not just impressions.

sources.author: David Okoro
sources.headline: VP Revenue Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Outlined a quarterly GTM planning process that integrates outbound automation, ABM targeting, and sales capacity modeling. Emphasized building feedback loops between marketing and sales data.

sources.author: Sofia Patel
sources.headline: GTM Strategist & Automation Lead @ Webflow
sources.post_summary: Posted about replacing manual outbound with AI-personalized sequences while maintaining brand voice. Shared results from a 3-month pilot showing 2.4x reply rate improvement.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Typedream | No-code builder | Ex-Meta
sources.post_summary: Shared the journey of building and shipping a new AI feature for Typedream in under 48 hours as a solo founder. Highlighted the importance of rapid iteration, user feedback loops, and how small daily builds compound into meaningful product progress.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Founder @ Row Zero | Ex-Google, Stanford
sources.post_summary: Detailed the decision to leave a stable tech job to build a spreadsheet tool for data teams. Discussed the emotional and financial realities of the career pivot, early traction metrics, and lessons from talking to first 50 customers.

sources.author: Shaan Puri
sources.headline: Founder @ Beacons | Ex-CEO @ DoorDash Labs
sources.post_summary: Posted about going back to being a solo builder after years of managing large teams. Shared his current weekly cadence of shipping small experiments publicly and how this approach reignited creativity and direct user connection.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Indie Maker | Founder @ Nomad List, Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Shared progress on a new micro-SaaS built entirely solo in a week. Included revenue numbers from the first few days, tech stack choices, and reflections on staying small and profitable versus raising funding.

sources.author: Sara Mauskopf
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Winnie | Ex-Google, YouTube
sources.post_summary: Wrote about transitioning from big tech to founding a marketplace startup. Covered the mindset shift required, how she validates ideas quickly with real users, and the value of publicly documenting both wins and setbacks.
